title: Beyond Attribute-Centric Fairness: Modelling and Mitigating Unified Bias Representation in Omni-modal Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.22889v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Omni-modal large language models (OLLMs) provide joint multimodal understanding and generation capabilities, making them well-suited to complex environments and promising backbones for next-generation AI. Despite these advances, the harmful stereotypes encoded in such models manifest in increasingly diverse forms, leading to broader and more severe societal consequences. Existing debiasing methods typically impose separate fairness objectives for each sensitive attribute and modality to minimise demographic-dependent variations. However, in omni-modal settings, this attribute-centric paradigm struggles to jointly address diverse social biases with distinct fairness objectives and to generalise beyond predefined attributes. translated_title: 超越以属性为中心的公平性：全模态大语言模型中统一偏见表征的建模与缓解
translated_abstract: 全模态大语言模型具备联合的多模态理解与生成能力，使其非常适合复杂环境，并有望成为下一代人工智能的骨干模型。尽管取得了这些进展，此类模型中编码的有害刻板印象正以日益多样化的形式显现，带来更广泛、更严重的社会后果。现有的去偏方法通常对每个敏感属性和模态分别施加公平性目标，以最小化与人口群体相关的差异。然而，在全模态场景下，这种以属性为中心的范式难以用不同的公平性目标联合应对多样化的社会偏见，也难以泛化到预定义属性之外。为此，我们提出了OmniDebias，这是首批面向全模态大语言模型公平性的方法之一，它采用以偏见为中心的建模方式，提取并缓解跨属性和模态的共享偏见表征。
tldr: 提出了OmniDebias——首批面向全模态大语言模型的去偏方法之一，通过建模并缓解跨属性与模态的统一共享偏见表征，突破了传统以属性为中心的公平性范式的局限。
en_tdlr: Proposes OmniDebias, one of the first debiasing methods for omni-modal large language models, which models and mitigates a unified shared bias representation across attributes and modalities, moving beyond the limitations of attribute-centric fairness paradigms.
